context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 136 added PendingLegalDocsGate - a blocking login gate that appears after authentication when user has unread required legal documents. Gate shows full-screen overlay with document fields (heading, checkbox, signature tested), validates required fields client-side with toast errors, POSTs acceptance to backend, and dismisses after all pending docs accepted. Backend validates required fields (400 on missing), records responses/version/IP. Pending list returns new versions if admin creates and activates them. Privacy Policy now at v1.3 (all versions accepted by admin).
